title: Add signed release manifests

context.summary: Sign and verify release manifests for bootstrap installers.
context.background: Checksums prove integrity only after trusting the manifest; public installers need signature verification.

in: Add release manifest signing during bundle generation.
Add public key verification in install.sh and install.ps1.
Add diagnostics for download, checksum and signature failures.
Add tests for tampered manifest and tampered artifact cases.
Remove TASK-107-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Managing production signing key custody outside repository guidance.

acceptance_criteria: Release bundle generation produces a signed manifest.
Bootstrap scripts verify manifest signatures before trusting checksums.
Tampered manifests and artifacts are rejected with distinct diagnostics.
Docs explain public key configuration and rotation process.

manual_checks: Confirm private signing keys are not committed.

risks: Signature implementation must be reproducible in Linux, macOS and Windows bootstrap paths.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
